stem.flightsim.coaching_challenge_comple: An ga cewa an cika manufofin ƙalubalen. Yanzu, a atisayen sarrafa makamashi, kwatanta saukar tsawo da injin ke aiki a hankali da hawan tsawo da ƙarfin injin.
stem.flightsim.coaching_energy_complete: An ga cewa an cika manufofin sarrafa makamashi. Yanzu ka yi atisayen sarrafa makamashi yayin gajeriyar kusantar filin jirgi, sannan ka kwatanta saurin saukar tsawo da taɓa ƙasa.
stem.flightsim.drone_battery_low: Batiri ya yi ƙasa: {pct}% ya rage. Koma wurin tashin jirgin ka sauka nan da nan.
stem.flightsim.drone_battery_depleted_ti: Batirin jirgin marar matuƙi ya ƙare
stem.flightsim.drone_battery_depleted_bo: An dakatar da tafiyar jirgin na ɗan lokaci saboda batiri ya kai 0%. Kammala aikin don nazarin wannan yunƙurin, sannan ka fara sabon aiki da cikakken batiri.
stem.flightsim.geoq_nearest_place: Wane wuri ne ya fi kusa da inda kake yanzu?
stem.flightsim.geoq_paused: An dakatar da tafiyar jirgin na ɗan lokaci saboda wannan tambayar. Rufe gwajin, sannan ka zaɓi Ci gaba idan ka shirya tashi.
stem.flightsim.geoq_unavailable: Babu tambayar ilimin ƙasa game da wurin da ke kusa. Ci gaba da bincike ka sake gwadawa.
